# Magnific recipes for TTE social posts

Reverse-engineered from Lucas's approved Magnific jobs (12/11/2026). These cover the images that are
**generated by design** in the post kit: the B&W figures of the Editorial carousel (F3) and the tactical
maps of the Mission Briefing (F1), Biomes (F2), Gerais (F5) and Dossiê (S4) posts. Everything else in the
kit uses real photography curated by Lucas (see the main skill: real people and places first).

Always generate inside the TTE project folder in Magnific (`folderReference 184b1d25-a52d-4f83-b2da-8a1da638bb5b`)
and **attach the same style references** listed below. The references carry the style; the prompt only
names the subject and the composition. Check the price with `simulate_cost` before generating, and look at
the result (`creations_read`) before using it.

## How the recipes work

```
[SUBJECT, one line] + [COMPOSITION line] + "Use the attached images as style references."
```

- Keep the subject literal and short ("a judean woman from the first century on her knees", "ancient clay
  tablet written in ancient hebrew"). Do not describe the style in words: the references do it.
- No people from real life by name; biblical and historical figures are generic types.
- Output is always B&W on a white/seamless background, so the background can be removed in Figma
  (or with `images_remove_background`) and the figure sits on the off-white slide.

## 1. Editorial · simple · illustration (engraving)

Source job: https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/dtOwIWwXSL

| | |
|---|---|
| Model | GPT 2.5 (`gpt-2-mini`, variant *flare*), 2k |
| Ratio | 1:1 for objects; 4:5 or 9:16 for figures |
| Style refs (5) | `If4GScLtvE` (Doré-style engraving, rider on a winged horse), `1lVIGECr4r`, `YMr7FZBWeC`, `tC9zUotmZJ`, `LwevcSeswO` — classic engraving/etching illustrations, isolated on white |
| Prompt | `Illustration of [subject]` ⏎ `Use the same illustration style of the attached images` |
| Example | `Illustration of ancient clay tablet written in ancient hebrew` |

Look: fine cross-hatched engraving, isolated object/figure, lots of white around it.

## 2. Editorial · simple · photography (small figures, side or top view)

Source job: https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/kscrzqt16B

| | |
|---|---|
| Model | GPT 2.5 (`gpt-2-mini`, variant *flare*), 2k |
| Ratio | 9:16 (figure small in a big white field) |
| Style refs (6) | `huObB98vqL` (lone man seen from above on a white plaza, hard shadow), `YMqXZScWeC`, `dtsfT2rXSL`, `1ln7HCKr4r`, `MBrmYcODCm`, `5jASQUmKxe` — high-key B&W street photography, tiny figures, long hard shadows |
| Prompt | `[subject]` ⏎⏎ `Side view black and white composition. White seamless background.` ⏎⏎ `Use the attached images as style references.` |
| Example | `a judean woman from the first century on her knees` + side view line |

Variations: swap `Side view` for `Top view` (people walking, seen from above). Mostly people; objects
also work. The figure must stay small and the hard shadow is part of the look.

## 3. Editorial · rich (large figures that can cross slides)

Source job: https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/5jTY4scKxe

| | |
|---|---|
| Model | GPT 2.6 (`gpt-2-6`, variant *sunburst*, thinking medium), 2k |
| Ratio | 9:16 |
| Style refs (4) | `u5zH7mcQLD` (blurred high-key B&W crowd silhouettes from above), `nVxcaW4YQD`, `p87Xbk4ehw`, `lJoUzqogv9` — blurred, dreamy B&W silhouette photography |
| Prompt | `Black and white photography of [subject]` ⏎ `Use the attached blurred silhouette black and white photography as style reference` |
| Example | `Black and white photography of an ancient letter scroll with a modern iPhone 18 pro above the letter` |

Look: large subject, motion blur and soft focus at the edges, deep soft shadows, white ground. In Figma the
figure goes in **two layers with the same image** (Multiply below + Screen with the dither shader above).
Crop generously: it is meant to cross the slide border.

## 4. Tactical maps (F1, F2, F5, S4)

Source jobs: https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/ovPt3jC829 (Malay Peninsula) ·
https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/gOBCqM4SXO (Rajasthan, India) ·
https://www.magnific.com/app/creation/xSMa0sTjfW (West Africa, several countries)

| | |
|---|---|
| Model | Google Nano Banana 2.1 (`imagen-nano-banana-2-1`) by default; Magnific One for harder geography |
| Ratio | 9:16 for slides; 16:9 when the map spans 2 slides |
| Style ref (1) | `yiZNgvLPW9` (the original Thailand tactical map), attached as `@img1` |
| Prompt template | see below |

```
Create a tactical black-and-white map focusing on [REGION]. The borders are all in thin outlines.
[REGION] area outline is little thicker and in orange #FE5442. Black background and white lines,
except the orange borders of [REGION]

Show all the [REGION / COUNTRY] border extension.
Do not represent names, map elements, just the geopolitical map of [REGION / COUNTRY] with its border
in the centre. Depict the geopolitical map with the right proportions and mercator scale.
Use @img1 just as a style reference
```

- `[REGION]` can be a country, a province inside a country ("the province Rajasthan inside of India"),
  a peninsula, or a list of countries.
- Careful with copy-paste leftovers: one source job still says "India area outline" in a West Africa
  prompt. Replace every region mention.
- **Check the geography** against a real map before using it: the models invent coastlines and borders.
  A wrong border on a map about a real people group is a factual error, not a style issue.
- In Figma: map goes in Lighten (or Screen) over #28272A, faded at the edges with Glow/Fade.
